title: Inexcusableness
summary: INEXCU'SABLENESS, noun The quality of not admitting of excuse or justification; enormity beyond forgiveness or palliation. This inexcusableness is stated on the supposition that they knew God, but did

inlines.v: INEXCU'SABLENESS, noun The quality of not admitting of excuse or justification; enormity beyond forgiveness or palliation. This inexcusableness is stated on the supposition that they knew God, but did not glorify him.
